Overview

Consolidate your procurement by sourcing essential construction chemicals, waterproofing admixtures and site hardware alongside your steel and gabion order. We stock trusted waterproofing products such as Sika Hydrofuge, bonding agents, fasteners and daily site consumables to keep your project moving on schedule.

Typical specifications & options

Waterproofing & chemicals
Sika Hydrofuge water-repellent admixtures, mortar plasticisers, concrete curing and bonding agents
Fasteners & fixings
Common wire nails, roofing nails, masonry anchors, high-tensile bolts, nuts and threaded rods
Formwork & masonry
Tie rods, wing nuts, damp-proof course (DPC) membranes, polythene sheeting and brickforce mesh
Site consumables
Cutting & grinding discs, welding electrodes, protective hardware and general builder’s supplies

Specifications above reflect typical industry sizes and options in this category. Contact our Kigali desk to confirm current stock and exact grades for your order.
